{'text': '本德，奧勒岡州（美聯社）—— 十月某日正午時分，一名16歲少年將一支霰彈槍擲過一道矮鐵絲網圍欄，然後自己也翻過圍欄。', 'paragraph_context': 'BEND, Ore. (AP) — In the middle of an October day, a 16-year-old boy tossed a shotgun over a low chain-link fence. Then he climbed over it himself.'}

{'text': '圍欄內有個遊樂場，再經過一片寬闊的草地，便是他曾就讀的小學。校內有數百名兒童，當中包括幾個正在特殊需要班上課的學生——他當年也是如此。', 'paragraph_context': 'There was a playground and a broad grass field leading to an elementary school he once attended. Inside were hundreds of children, including a handful attending a special needs class — just like he had.'}

{'text': '現場還有一輛紅色貨車。警方和校方表示，貨車司機是至少三名冒著生命危險試圖阻止槍手的人之中的第一人。', 'paragraph_context': 'There was also a red truck. It was driven by the first of at least three people who would risk their own lives to try to stop him, according to accounts from police and school officials.'}

{'text': '司機大喊一聲，少年隨即開槍。他至少擊中貨車三次，但司機並無受傷——他駛離現場並報警。', 'paragraph_context': 'The driver yelled, and the boy started shooting. He hit the truck at least three times, but the driver wasn’t hurt — he drove down the road and called 911.'}

{'text': '附近還有另一名司機——36歲的木匠Kaylub Giamanco。他目睹少年向紅色貨車開槍，並正向Silver Rail小學走去。Giamanco的子女也在該校就讀。', 'paragraph_context': 'Nearby was another driver, Kaylub Giamanco, a 36-year-old carpenter. He saw the boy shooting at the red truck and heading toward the school, Silver Rail Elementary. Giamanco’s children go there.'}

{'text': '少年沿著校舍走到一扇鎖上的門前，用霰彈槍轟碎門上的玻璃。', 'paragraph_context': 'The boy walked along the school to a locked door. He blasted through its glass panes with the shotgun.'}

{'text': 'Giamanco將車駛入停車場。他身上也帶有槍械——一把合法存放於車上的.40口徑手槍。', 'paragraph_context': 'Giamanco drove into the parking lot. He had a gun too — a .40-caliber pistol legally stored in his vehicle.'}

{'text': '在破門旁邊的課室內，有教師和四名兒童。另一名教師則帶了一名一年級學生去了洗手間。', 'paragraph_context': 'In the classroom next to the broken door there were teachers and four children. Another teacher had taken a first-grader to the bathroom.'}

{'text': '少年走進門旁的一間課室，扣動霰彈槍的唧筒並扣下扳機，一而再、再而三。', 'paragraph_context': 'The boy entered a classroom next to the door. He pumped the shotgun and pulled the trigger. Over and over.'}

{'text': '帶一年級學生去洗手間的教師聽到槍聲，與學生一同躲進附近一間辦公室的桌子底下。', 'paragraph_context': 'The teacher and the first-grader who had gone to the restroom heard the gunshots. They hid under a table in a nearby office.'}

{'text': 'Giamanco同樣聽到槍聲，遂朝槍聲方向走去。', 'paragraph_context': 'Giamanco could hear the shooting too. He went toward it.'}

{'text': '課室內一名教師將手機擲向槍手。警方表示，她隨即將其撲倒。', 'paragraph_context': 'One of the teachers in the classroom threw a phone at the shooter. Then, police say, she tackled him.'}

{'text': 'Giamanco進入校內，看見一名女子正與少年扭打，爭奪霰彈槍。他隨即向少年連開數槍，將其擊斃。', 'paragraph_context': 'Inside the school Giamanco saw a woman wrestling with the boy for control of the shotgun. He shot the boy several times, killing him.'}

{'text': '與少年搏鬥的教師並無受傷，但課室內有三名兒童罹難，年齡分別為5歲、8歲及11歲。另一名兒童身受重傷。', 'paragraph_context': 'The teacher who wrestled with the boy wasn’t hurt. But three of the children in the classroom were killed. They were 5, 8 and 11 years old. Another was critically wounded.'}

{'text': '課室內有一名教師罹難：25歲的Megan Lambert。她的家人表示，教書是她夢寐以求的職業。另一名教師手臂及手部中槍。', 'paragraph_context': 'One teacher in the classroom was killed: 25-year-old Megan Lambert. Her family said teaching was her dream job. Another teacher was shot in the arm and in the hand.'}

{'text': 'Linda Sanchez是那名與老師一起躲在桌底的一年級男童的母親。她收到學校發出的封鎖錄音電話通知，並聽到救護車和警車駛往學校的聲音。', 'paragraph_context': 'Linda Sanchez is the mother of the first-grade boy who hid under the table with his teacher. She got a robocall about the lockdown and heard ambulances and police cars rushing toward the school.'}

{'text': '「我的心一直猛跳，因為他就在裡面，」Sanchez說道。', 'paragraph_context': '“My heart was just like pounding because he was in there,” Sanchez said.'}

{'text': '整個事發過程僅歷時數分鐘。警方迅速到場，幾乎在Giamanco開槍射殺少年Griffin John II之前抵達。事後，調查人員發現多達15枚已擊發的彈殼。少年身上還有約44發未使用的子彈。', 'paragraph_context': 'The entire series of events spanned just a few minutes. Police arrived quickly, just before Giamanco shot the boy, Griffin John II. In the aftermath investigators found as many as 15 spent shell casings. The boy had about 44 more unused rounds.'}

{'text': '在周五的記者會上，本德警察局長Mike Krantz等人對那些沒有袖手旁觀的人士表達謝意。', 'paragraph_context': 'At a news conference Friday, Bend Police Chief Mike Krantz and others expressed their appreciation for those who did not stand by.'}

{'text': '「我認為我們不能低估或輕視那份勇氣，」Krantz說。「當有人願意為他人冒生命危險時，我們會予以肯定。能夠迅速觀察判斷、然後泊車跟隨對方進入校內的應變能力實在難以置信，毫無疑問拯救了許多人。', 'paragraph_context': '“I don’t think we can underestimate or underappreciate that courage,” Krantz said. “When someone is willing to risk their own life for others, we recognize that. The quick thinking to observe, to then park and follow someone into the school is incredible and undoubtedly saved people.'}

{'text': '「如果這份勇氣是出自作為保護孩子的父親本能，那實在是了不起，」Krantz說。', 'paragraph_context': '“If it came natural as a protective father, that’s terrific,” Krantz said.'}

{'text': '局長續說：「那位願意挺身而出、為學生奮戰的教師——令人敬佩。我們都明白這才是真正的英雄行為。在現今社會，這樣的事並不常見。」', 'paragraph_context': '“The teacher who’s willing to stand and fight for her children — incredible,” the chief added. “We all recognize that is true heroism. We don’t see that a lot in society.”'}
